## Figure 1. ROS defense, generation and response pathways scores fusion with DST.

```{r Calculate_DST, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tools)
library(reshape2)
library(dplyr)



setwd('data/Fig1/')

# Read the single cell pathways scores evaluated by scanpy
matrix_data = readRDS('matrix_data.rds')
group = readRDS('group.rds')

# Divided the pathways scores into three perspects
antioxidant = matrix_data[,2:20]
response = matrix_data[,21:33]
generation = matrix_data[,34:49]


# Combine normalization and column-wise normalization into one function with bias
normalize_combined <- function(mat) {
  # Apply linear transformation to range [0, 1]
  min_vals <- apply(mat, 2, min)
  max_vals <- apply(mat, 2, max)
  scaled_mat <- sweep(mat, 2, min_vals, FUN = "-") # Subtract min
  scaled_mat <- sweep(scaled_mat, 2, max_vals - min_vals, FUN = "/") # Divide by range
  
  # Add a small bias to avoid zero division during column normalization
  bias <- 1e-10
  col_sums <- colSums(scaled_mat) + bias
  normalized_mat <- sweep(scaled_mat, 2, col_sums, FUN = "/")
  
  return(normalized_mat)
}


fusion <- function(a, b) {
  m1 <- as.numeric(a)
  m2 <- as.numeric(b)
  
  # Calculate conflict factor K
  K <- sum(m1 * m2)
  
  # Calculate combined evidence
  res <- sum(m1 * m2)
  
  K <- K - res
  
  # Compute the combined belief mass
  combined <- (m1 * m2) / (1 - K)
  
  # Normalize the combined belief mass
  normalized_combined <- combined / sum(combined)
  
  return(normalized_combined)
}



# Apply the combined normalization function
normalized_matrix <- normalize_combined(antioxidant)
# Define the fusion function
# Initialize combined belief with the first column
combined_belief <- normalized_matrix[, 1]
# Combine columns using fusion function
for (i in 2:ncol(normalized_matrix)) {
  combined_belief <- fusion(combined_belief, normalized_matrix[, i])
}

antioxidant$Antioxidant_fusion = combined_belief


normalized_matrix <- normalize_combined(generation)
combined_belief <- normalized_matrix[, 1]
# Combine columns using fusion function
for (i in 2:ncol(normalized_matrix)) {
  combined_belief <- fusion(combined_belief, normalized_matrix[, i])
}
generation$Generation_fusion = combined_belief


normalized_matrix <- normalize_combined(response)
combined_belief <- normalized_matrix[, 1]
# Combine columns using fusion function
for (i in 2:ncol(normalized_matrix)) {
  combined_belief <- fusion(combined_belief, normalized_matrix[, i])
}
response$Response_fusion = combined_belief



all_score=list(antioxidant = antioxidant, generation = generation, response = response)



group = matrix_data[,1:2]
group$Antioxidant_fusion = antioxidant$Antioxidant_fusion; group$Response_fusion = response$Response_fusion; group$Generation_fusion = generation$Generation_fusion


saveRDS(group[,-2],'three_DST_fusion_scores.rds')






# Add system information to the scores
group_melt = melt(group)

df_sorted_tissue_cluster <- group_melt %>% 
  group_by(tissue,variable) %>% 
  summarise(sum_avg_exp_scaled = mean(value),exp_per=sum(value>0)/length(value)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(sum_avg_exp_scaled),desc(exp_per)) 
df_sorted_tissue_cluster = df_sorted_tissue_cluster[,-4]
a1=dcast(df_sorted_tissue_cluster,formula = tissue~variable)

k = a1[order(a1$Antioxidant_fusion,decreasing = T)[1:50],]

# classified the scores by system
system =as.data.frame(readxl::read_xlsx('Tissue_cluster_system_meanscores.xlsx'))
a1$tissue_cluster = a1$tissue;a1 = a1[,-1]
a1 = merge(a1,system[,-1],by = 'tissue_cluster')


write.csv(a1,'three_DST_fusion_scores_with_group.csv')

```



## Figure 1. Outside circle.

```{r Draw1, echo=TRUE, fig.width=12, fig.height=12, out.width="100%"}


# Color palette
my36_colors <- c(
  "#E5D2DD", "#53A85F", "#F1BB72", "#F3B1A0", "#D6E7A3", "#57C3F3", "#476D87",
  "#E95C59", "#E59CC4", "#AB3282", "#23452F", "#BD956A", "#8C549C", "#585658",
  "#9FA3A8", "#E0D4CA", "#5F3D69", "#C5DEBA", "#58A4C3", "#E4C755", "#F7F398",
  "#AA9A59", "#E63863", "#E39A35", "#C1E6F3", "#6778AE", "#91D0BE", "#B53E2B",
  "#712820", "#DCC1DD", "#CCE0F5", "#CCC9E6", "#625D9E", "#68A180", "#3A6963",
  "#968175"
)

extra_colors <- colorspace::rainbow_hcl(18, start = 15, end = 375)

# Plot parameters
offset   <- 1e-5
ylim_max <- 2e-5
cutoff   <- 1.187016e-05

# Make sure 'tissue' exists in a1; if not, merge it back from your original table
# (example)
# a1 <- left_join(a1, unique(matrix_data[, c("tissue_cluster", "tissue")]),
#                 by = "tissue_cluster")

p <- ggplot(
  a1,
  aes(
    x     = tissue_cluster,
    y     = Antioxidant_fusion + offset,
    color = tissue    # <- key change: color by tissue, not tissue_cluster
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(my36_colors, extra_colors)) +
  coord_polar(start = pi / 2, direction = -1) +
  ylim(0, ylim_max) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid   = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = cutoff, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
  geom_text(
    data  = subset(a1, Antioxidant_fusion + offset > cutoff),
    aes(label = tissue_cluster),
    color = "black",
    vjust = -1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data  = subset(a1, Antioxidant_fusion + offset > cutoff),
    color = "red",
    size  = 2
  )

p



```


## Figure 1. Inside dimension

```{r Draw2, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
# Color palette for systems
system_col <- c(
  "#8CC2DB", "#587FA7", "#C13E65", "#742929", "#A7CDDA",
  "#333866", "#EEC161", "#F2DF96", "#4E6AAE", "#DA437F", "#BF3C4C"
)

# Ensure 'system' is a factor
a1$system <- factor(a1$system)

# Map system levels to colors
system_levels <- levels(a1$system)
system_colors <- setNames(system_col[seq_along(system_levels)], system_levels)

# Assign a color to each row based on system
a1$system_color <- system_colors[a1$system]

# Create output directory
dir.create("fig", showWarnings = FALSE)

## ---- 1) Draw on screen ----
pairs(
  a1[, c("Antioxidant_fusion", "Response_fusion", "Generation_fusion")],
  col = a1$system_color,
  pch = 19
)
legend(
  "topright",
  legend = system_levels,
  fill   = system_colors[system_levels],
  title  = "System"
)


## (optional) 3) Save as PDF
pdf("fig/Fig1_fusion_pairs.pdf", width = 7, height = 7)
pairs(
  a1[, c("Antioxidant_fusion", "Response_fusion", "Generation_fusion")],
  col = a1$system_color,
  pch = 19
)
legend(
  "topright",
  legend = system_levels,
  fill   = system_colors[system_levels],
  title  = "System"
)
dev.off()

```


## Figure S1 (B) Generation scores ranks

```{r Draw3, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
# 绘制散点图
f <- a1[order(a1$Generation_fusion, decreasing = TRUE),
        c("tissue_cluster", "Generation_fusion", "system")][1:50, ]

f$tissue_cluster <- factor(f$tissue_cluster, levels = f$tissue_cluster)

ggplot(f, aes(x = tissue_cluster, y = Generation_fusion, color = system)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +  # points
  geom_text(aes(label = tissue_cluster), angle = 90, hjust = -0.5, size = 3) +  # show tissue labels
  # facet_wrap(~Category, scales = "free_x", ncol = 1) +  # optional faceting
  theme_minimal() +  # clean theme
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_blank(),   # hide x-axis labels
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()    # hide x-axis ticks
  )

```
